# Terra at Skyeview | Homebuying with Dr. Jan Duffy

Dr. Jan Duffy, REALTOR® with BHHS Nevada Properties (license S.0197614).
Model home: 8592 Vanhoy Creek Street, Las Vegas, NV 89166.
Phone: (702) 919-7292 · Email: DrJanSells@TerraSkyeview.com
Canonical site: https://www.terraskyeview.com

## Facts (sourced on this site)

- Terra at Skyeview is a Century Communities collection of new two-story homes in Skye Canyon, Las Vegas NV 89166.
- Three floor plans (Residence 1792, 1943, 2119): about 1,792–2,119 sq ft; list pricing published from $479,990 on /communities/skyeview.
- Homebuying with Dr. Jan Duffy: register before touring; buyer representation is $0 to the buyer on new construction here.
- Model hours: Monday–Saturday 10:00 AM–6:00 PM; Sunday 11:00 AM–6:00 PM.
